desc: The MAAD Brake 2.0 is the perfect hub for all of SilencerCo’s accessories. It comes in Alpha, Bravo and Charlie varieties and is the central host for our front caps including different apertures, flash hiders, and the three-port anchor brake. The MAAD Brake 2.0 minimizes recoil and muzzle climb without adding excessive length at just 2.235″. It’s a great option for shooters who want to keep their overall profile compact but still reduce recoil. The MAAD Brake can be mounted using any of our SilencerCo systems including the ASR mount, direct thread, pistons, 3-lug and TOM mount.
